order: Add /ultra-plan, a two-model adversarial planning roundabout. The Director drafts a plan under full planning discipline, then hands it to a counterpart from a different vendor, which either approves it or returns a numbered critique plus a counter-draft. The Director arbitrates, and the plan ping-pongs until either side approves the standing plan unchanged. Cap the rounds at four, escalate a stalemate to the user, and append a log of verdicts and dispositions to the plan file. Build three pieces mirroring the cross-vendor review lane — a zero-dependency runner that calls the counterpart's API and degrades every failure to an unavailable verdict rather than a fake approval, a thin launcher that relays verbatim and never plans itself, and the skill document holding the protocol. In the installer, add only the new agent name, the runner copy and its uninstall entry, and leave its existing copy and stamping behaviour as the base has it.
claims: The runner, the launcher and the skill document are in place, and the roundabout logs its verdicts and dispositions to the plan file. Every failure path degrades to an unavailable verdict rather than a fake approval. The installer gained the new agent name, the runner copy and its uninstall entry; no other change was made. A syntax check passes on the new runner and the installer, and a round-trip into a fresh temporary directory installed all four skills and the runner.
